verdict.rationale: Brex's own materials say AI agents categorize spend instantly, write memos and fetch receipts for employees, and auto-match uploaded receipts to expenses. They position this as closing the books in real time, and prepared expense data syncs automatically to the accounting system. A community comment independently mentions auto-generated receipts and data enrichment. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of merchant enrichment and GL/category mapping depth, and hands-on evidence that coding accuracy actually reduces month-end review work.

support.subject: As a finance lead, spend is coded as it happens — merchant, category, memo, receipt — so month-end close is a review, not an archaeology dig

citations.quote: Stop waiting for people to categorize, review, or approve spend. Let AI agents do it instantly, based on your policies and with total transparency.
AI assistants do employees' expenses for them, writing memos, fetching receipts, offering policy help, even filing reimbursements automatically.
Receipt Match: Upload receipt and match automatically.
Manage global spend and close the books in real time — with unmatched automation of manual expense work.
Prepared expense data sync automatically to eliminate manual set up or matching between Brex and Puzzle.
